The '''Orb of Passage''' was an old artifact contained in the [[Temple of Tet-Ami]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Benja-Rihn]]. It was guarded by a statue of a great hero named [[Mace Windu/Legends|Tet-Ami]], the Time Guardian, who saved the armies of [[Carthas]] from a plague of insect-like beasts in an epic battle. This device was said to control the flow of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Sometime after its construction, the orb was secretly taken by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and knowledge of the temple was lost.
